title: "Schedule"
subtitle: "Three half days, about four hours each."

Times assume a 9:00 start. Shift them as needed. Each day ends at a stopping point, so anyone who missed a session can copy it and pick up the next day.

::: {.schedule}

## Ending at a stopping point

Fell behind, or missed a day? Copy the last stopping point and work from there. From the course folder:

```bash
cp -r stopping-points/stopB my-cold-chain-b
cd my-cold-chain-b
npm install
npm run dev
```

## Running it as two full days

Day 1 as above, then day 2 through lesson 6 in the afternoon. Day 3 becomes the second full day, with the capstone kickoff stretched to an hour.
